params.command: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.Name -in @('Runner.Listener.exe','Runner.Worker.exe','powershell.exe','pwsh.exe') -and ($_.ExecutablePath -like '*actions-runner-heaven*' -or $_.CommandLine -like '*actions-runner-heaven*') } | Select-Object ProcessId,ParentProcessId,Name,ExecutablePath,CommandLine | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 4; Get-ChildItem "$env:USERPROFILE\actions-runner-heaven\_diag" -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Sort-Object LastWriteTime -Descending | Select-Object -First 5 Name,Length,LastWriteTime | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 3
